title: Monthly KTMB Ridership
description: Monthly-frequency ridership data for the 5 main KTMB services, namely Komuter, Komuter Utara, Intercity, ETS and Shuttle Tebrau.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency

fields.name: service
fields.title: Service
fields.description: [String] One of 5 services (Komuter, Komuter Utara, Intercity, ETS, Shuttle Tebrau) in lower snake case

fields.name: ridership
fields.title: Ridership
fields.description: [Integer] Number of trips taken using the service; it should be noted that this may not equal the number of passengers, as a single passenger may take multiple trips within the same month

methodology: This dataset is derived from anonymous transactional data generated by the KTMB Integrated Ticketing System (KITS). The aggregated monthly totals are calculated by summing passenger counts across all origin-destination pairs for each service type (ETS, Intercity, Komuter, Komuter Utara, and Shuttle Tebrau), thus providing a snapshot of ridership across all KTMB services. As such, it is 100% consistent with the granular origin-destination data published on our site.
caveat: It should be noted that the starting date is different across the different services, due to the phased roll-out of KITS, from which the data is derived.
publication: Our site features a [dashboard on KTMB ridership](https://data.gov.my/dashboard/ktmb-explorer) where you can explore this data in a more interactive manner.
